wholePhysicalScope: Native mapped masonry outlines, exact published entrance image, public-domain exterior view, monastery history and sourced hillside data.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the hillside range, tiled gables, entrance gate, small bellcote and garden pavilions.
limitations: Gate placement beside the downhill end of the attached mapped range and the subdivision of the garden elevation are inferred from the reference views and hillside geometry. Roof and storey heights are estimated.
Model covers the mapped attached masonry group. Detached agricultural and village buildings, interiors and gardens are outside this model.
